research_metadata.task_context: Machi cold brew coffee landing page redesign

recommended_color_system.rationale: Extracted from machi reference: sky blue atmosphere, white surfaces, pastel product tints, dark espresso typography

recommended_typography.display_font: Inter Black 900 for hero and wordmark
recommended_typography.rationale: Bold grotesque sans-serif matches machi heavy display typography. Free via Google Fonts, has Black 900 weight

design_signals.recommended_animation_approach: Pure CSS @keyframes float/float-slow/float-diagonal. Zero JS animation deps. One orchestrated moment: hero floating cups. Everything static.
trending_components: Floating beverage hero with parallax clouds
Pastel rounded product cards with hover lift
Editorial dark split banner with stat grid
Organic lifestyle banner with decorative floats
anti_patterns_to_avoid: rainbow_gradients: Use specific sky blue palette only
motion_excess: One motion moment only (floating cups hero)
lorem ipsum: All copy must be real machi-style branding
card_jail: Use whitespace not 1px bordered cards
generic_hero: Immersive floating-object atmosphere, not left-text-right-image

local_components.name: ShaderBackground
local_components.use_case: Optional 3D fluid mesh gradient behind hero

local_components.name: LiquidGlassPanel
local_components.use_case: Optional liquid glass refraction on pastel product cards

community_verdict.sentiment_summary: CSS @keyframes preferred over JS libraries for float/pulse effects. Lower bundle, GPU-accelerated.
key_warnings: No Framer Motion for simple float animations — pure CSS lighter
Build custom sky gradient with exact hex stops, not generic Tailwind classes
Use animation-delay for staggered entry to avoid robotic synchronous floating
key_endorsements: Tailwind CSS for utility styling — already in project via CDN
CSS @keyframes for floating elements — proven in 3+ repos
Pure HTML for giant wordmark — text-[16rem] font-black, no JS needed

pattern_evidence: Cloud parallax: REAR 0.25, FRONT 0.5 speed proven sky layering
Giant wordmark: text-[8-16rem] font-black pure CSS pattern

ui_precedents: Machi cold brew reference: sky gradient hero, floating cups, pastel cards, editorial stats, wordmark footer
Dribbble cold brew landing: blue sky + floating beverage compositions
Awwwards coffee brand: bold typography + pastel product showcases
